coordinates: glTF Y-up +Z-forward; quaternion xyzw; seconds; absolute local TRS; standalone rest reset, simultaneous masks in MotionLayering.json
disabled: turret settles 0.014u with gentle 0.025rad pitch; no launcher buried in the shell, motor stopped; harmless toy
ghostVisibility: opaque geometry; controller visibility and track FX only
rotationInterpolation: shortest-path normalized SLERP between adjacent keys
application: Absolute local TRS for every named root, mesh and socket node at every key. Standalone diagnostics reset all nodes to rest. Simultaneous controller layers apply only the per-property masks in MotionLayering.json; never reset the driven root or unrelated channels per event.
